description: This PHP source file defines the AuthValidateController class within the OrangeHRM project. The class handles authentication validation requests by processing user credentials, invoking the authentication service, and returning JSON responses indicating success or failure.

classes.name: AuthValidateController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for validating user authentication, processing login credentials, and returning a JSON response indicating authentication success or failure.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the AuthenticationService instance used for credential validation.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming HTTP request, extracts credentials, performs authentication, updates the user's authentication status, and returns the response.
